caption: The video captures a low, water-level view of a shallow forest stream flowing beneath an overcast sky. On the left bank, deciduous trees hang over the channel with yellow-orange autumn leaves, while mossy rocks line the near edge; the right bank rises as a dense wall of green conifers and pale birch trunks. A line of dark stones spans the far bank, and a single dark rock protrudes from the mid-left channel. The framing of the trees, banks, and rocks remains fixed, so the visible motion is carried by the moving water surface. That surface continuously ripples and churns, the bright sky-reflection band shifting shape from moment to moment. Small white foam patches and turbulent streaks deform and drift across the surface as the flow progresses. The stream's flow is already underway when the view opens and continues without pause.
